decisions.decision: Use DOM-attached fixed element for setDragImage instead of detached memory canvas
decisions.rationale: WebKit on macOS strictly cancels drag sessions if setDragImage is called with a detached off-screen canvas

decisions.decision: Encode multi-photo IDs as CSV string in text/plain clipboard payload
decisions.rationale: Ensures full photo array reaches drop target even when native OS pasteboard sanitizes custom MIME types

decisions.decision: Adopt Playwright Chromium headless for automated E2E browser validation
decisions.rationale: Validates actual UI rendering, mouse drag-and-drop, and Konva stage geometry 1:1 against real web engine
